stories.title: Afyonkarahisar Ticaret Borsası Başkanı'nın oğlunun sucuk markası tağşiş listesinde

en.title: Son of Afyonkarahisar Chamber of Commerce President's Sausage Brand on Adulteration List
en.summary: The sausage brand of the son of Afyonkarahisar Chamber of Commerce President Mehmet Mühsürler has appeared on the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry's list of adulterated food products.

stories.title: SPK eski başkanı şüpheli sıfatıyla ifade verdi

en.title: Former SPK Chairman Testifies as Suspect
en.summary: Former Capital Markets Board Chairman İbrahim Ömer Gönül provided testimony as a suspect in a capital markets investigation in Istanbul.

stories.title: Çorlu’da 17 yaşındaki motosiklet sürücüsü kazada hayatını kaybetti

en.title: 17-Year-Old Motorcycle Driver Dies in Accident in Çorlu
en.summary: A 17-year-old motorcyclist died after his vehicle collided with an unidentified vehicle in Çorlu, Tekirdağ. The motorcycle overturned in the impact.

stories.title: Balkondan düşen 77 yaşındaki kadın hayatını kaybetti

en.title: 77-Year-Old Woman Dies After Falling from Balcony
en.summary: A 77-year-old woman who fell from the fourth-floor balcony of her home in central Erzincan died at the hospital where she was taken.

stories.title: Fon soruşturmasında yeni kriz! AKP'li Hayati Yazıcı'nın oğluna yurtdışı yasağı

en.title: New crisis in fund investigation! Travel ban imposed on son of AKP's Hayati Yazıcı
en.summary: In a fund investigation, the son of AKP Vice Chairman Hayati Yazıcı has been issued a travel ban and his assets have been frozen as part of legal proceedings.

stories.title: 4. kattan düşen 77 yaşındaki kadın hayatını kaybetti

en.title: 77-year-old woman who fell from 4th floor dies
en.summary: A 77-year-old woman in Erzincan died after falling from the fourth floor of an apartment building. Police launched an investigation into the cause of the incident.

stories.title: İstanbul'a giden uçakta şok olay... Kabin memurunu ve yolcuyu ısırdı: Uçuşlardan men edildi

en.title: Shocking incident on Istanbul-bound flight: Passenger bit flight attendant and another passenger, banned from flights
en.summary: A passenger on an AJet flight from London Stansted to Istanbul Sabiha Gökçen bit a flight attendant and another passenger. The passenger was detained by police and banned from flying.

stories.title: İstanbul uçağında akılalmaz olay: Kabin memuruyla yolcuyu ısırdı

en.title: Unbelievable incident on Istanbul flight: Passenger bit flight attendant and passenger
en.summary: An incident occurred on an AJet flight from London Stansted to Istanbul Sabiha Gökçen when a passenger on board caused a disturbance.

stories.title: Fon soruşturmasında 5 isim hakkında tedbir kaldırıldı: Aralarında AKP’li Hayati Yazıcı’nın oğlu da var

en.title: Five names have restrictions lifted in fund investigation: AKP member Hayati Yazıcı's son among them
en.summary: Restrictions on five individuals under investigation by Istanbul's chief prosecutor's office in a fund case were lifted. The list included Mustafa Yazıcı, son of AKP Vice Chairman Hayati Yazıcı.

stories.title: NATO Genel Sekreteri’nden Putin’i küplere bindirecek sözler

en.title: NATO Secretary General's words to infuriate Putin
en.summary: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte warned Russia regarding an anticipated imminent threat directed at NATO territory.

en.title: Former CMB Chairman gave statement
en.summary: A former Capital Markets Board chairman provided testimony in a fund investigation being conducted by Istanbul prosecutors under capital markets law violations.

stories.title: NATO Genel Sekreteri Rutte’den Putin’e mesaj: NATO’yu asla yenemeyeceğini biliyor

en.title: NATO Secretary General Rutte's message to Putin: Knows NATO can never be defeated
en.summary: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte responded to nuclear threats from Russia by conveying NATO's message to cease nuclear threats and stating that Putin understands NATO cannot be defeated.

stories.title: A1 Capital, Bulls ve Pardus Portföy fonları için tasfiye sırası belirlendi

en.title: A1 Capital, Bulls and Pardus Portfolio funds liquidation order determined
en.summary: The securities regulator established the sequence for liquidating funds within A1 Capital, Bulls and Pardus Portfolio, starting with money market funds and continuing with funds having the highest number of investors.

stories.title: 110 milyar dolarlık Hollywood savaşında kilit açıldı: Kontrol el değiştiriyor

en.title: Key unlocked in 110 billion dollar Hollywood battle: Control changing hands
en.summary: A critical decision was reached in the long-disputed 110 billion dollar Paramount-Warner Bros. deal, clearing the way for some of Hollywood's most powerful brands to consolidate under single ownership.

stories.title: Altında satış bitti mi? Morgan Stanley’den 5 bin dolar çıkışı

en.title: Has gold selling ended? Morgan Stanley sees 5 thousand dollar exit from gold
en.summary: Gold started the new month near 4,150 dollars following September losses, with softening US inflation insufficient to stop selling pressure as attention turned to upcoming employment data and Morgan Stanley's assessment of the 4,000 dollar level.

stories.title: Trump duyurdu: Güney Kore'den ABD'ye 200 milyar dolarlık yatırım

en.title: Trump announces: 200 billion dollar investment from South Korea to US
en.summary: US President Donald Trump announced that South Korea will invest up to 200 billion dollars in US energy projects, including a 6 gigawatt power plant in Texas, 8 nuclear plants, and an Alaska LNG project. This investment forms part of a broader 350 billion dollar commitment.

stories.title: Siber Güvenlik Başkanlığı’nda yeni atamalar Resmi Gazete’de

en.title: New appointments at Cyber Security Directorate published in Official Gazette
en.summary: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan signed a decision announcing new appointments to deputy head and various director positions at the Cyber Security Directorate.
